svg.title: Exact 3D Projection of Hierarchical Curved State Spaces
svg.desc: A data-generated orthographic projection of a radius 20 global sphere, four radius 6 local spheres centered on its surface, and radius 2 secondary spheres centered on each local sphere surface.
svg.text: Figure 3. Exact 3D Hierarchy of Curved State Spaces
R=20 global sphere; R'=6 centers on its surface; R''=2 centers on each local surface.

g.text: C0=(0,0,0), radius 20. Four R'=6 centers lie at N, S, E0, E180 on the R=20 surface.
For each local center C, the R''=2 center is C + 6 C/||C||, exactly on the local sphere surface.
This is a toy-model state-space hierarchy, not a physical fractal spacetime claim.
is placed by the same surface-center rule.
